item.title: Ask HN: Move AI news from Hacker News to somewhere else? (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: There seems to be a real need for updated news on all the latest AI models, pricing, performance, how to self host the models and legislations. Is it really hacking or is just AI business news? Maybe it is time to move AI news to somewhere else? May be it would have been best if the Lisp/Arc developers at Y Combinator would be kind enough to implement a filter for AI news? item.title: Ask HN: How do you use AI for learning? (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: This is an interesting use case that gets talked about much less, and potentially one that is more useful than software development. Especially now that everyone is relying heavily on AI and even forgetting things they used to know. Have you explored this yourself or found any existing workflows for mastering technologies, concepts, theory, basically everything that we have traditionally learned manually, from university onward?
